answer_1.quote: The explanation task generates some explainable texts to provide an informative summarization for the restaurant's management.
answer_1.outputs: Summarization text explaining why a restaurant will prosper or close

answer_2.quote: BLEU and ROUGE are used to evaluate the explanation task. ROUGE's evaluation is based on the co-occurrence information of n-grams in the text. ROUGE-N (N=1,2) mainly counts on the N-grams. ROUGE-L is calculated by matching the longest common subsequence. ROUGE-SU4 is calculated by the skipgram strategy...

answer_4.quote: The fluency evaluation experiment is done by human judgment. We randomly selected 100 samples and invited 5 annotators to assign scores.
answer_4.guideline: Five points mean very satisfied, and 1 point means very bad.
